description: Lyra controlled Crypto Kennel and related fronts.
The network used trust, small wins, upgrades and urgency to increase deposits.
Displayed balances and gains did not match external assets and prices.
Bone Vault tokens and contracts used common admin infrastructure.
Withdrawals were blocked and conditioned on external release fees.
Deposits were swept, bridged offshore and distributed to operators.
Domestic funding moved through cash-out agents to offshore accounts.
Gavin and Vera knowingly facilitated while Tessa lacked platform control.
Nora moderated messages but did not control prices, wallets or withdrawals.
Clara, Henry, ClearChain and Open Paw provide legitimate comparison activity.
